A display apparatus comprises a display panel and a frame positioned behind the display panel. The frame has a base portion and a side wall projecting from the base portion. A substrate is disposed on the frame, multiple light sources are installed on the substrate, and a reflective sheet is arranged over the substrate.

The reflective sheet includes a first sheet portion located on the base portion. This first sheet portion is rectangular and has a first long edge, a second long edge facing the first long edge, a first short edge adjoining both long edges, and a second short edge facing the first short edge. The first sheet portion also has multiple openings aligned with the multiple light sources.

The reflective sheet further includes a second sheet portion that extends from the first sheet portion toward the frame’s side wall. A plurality of dots is provided on the second sheet portion. These dots lower the reflectivity of light, and their sizes become larger from a corner of the second sheet portion along both a first direction parallel to the long edges and a second direction parallel to the short edges.

The display device includes a display panel, a rear frame, a substrate, a plurality of light sources, and a reflecting sheet. The rear frame is positioned behind the display panel and has a bottom portion and a sidewall extending from the bottom portion. The substrate is disposed on the rear frame, and the plurality of light sources are mounted on the substrate to emit light toward the display panel. The reflecting sheet is arranged on the rear frame to reflect light emitted from the light sources toward the display panel, thereby improving light utilization efficiency.

The reflecting sheet includes a first sheet part disposed on the bottom portion of the rear frame. The first sheet part has a substantially rectangular shape defined by two long sides and two short sides. A plurality of holes is formed in the first sheet part, and the holes are positioned to correspond to the respective locations of the light sources mounted on the substrate. Each light source may be exposed through a corresponding hole so that light emitted from the light sources can pass through the reflecting sheet and be reflected and diffused within the display device.

The reflecting sheet further includes a second sheet part extending from the first sheet part toward the sidewall of the rear frame. The second sheet part is configured to reflect light in an edge region of the display device. A plurality of dots is provided on the second sheet part to reduce light reflectance in selected areas. The dots are arranged such that their size increases from a corner of the reflecting sheet in directions parallel to both the long sides and the short sides of the first sheet part. By varying the dot size in this manner, the reflectance of the second sheet part can be locally adjusted, helping to reduce brightness non-uniformity near the corners and edges of the display device.
outputs.L4:
A display device is provided that includes a rear frame, a light-source substrate, and a reflecting sheet arranged inside the rear frame. The rear frame forms a supporting structure of the display device and accommodates optical components used to illuminate a display panel. The light-source substrate is disposed along the rear frame and includes a plurality of light sources, such as LEDs, for emitting light toward the display panel.

The reflecting sheet is positioned so as to reflect light emitted from the light sources and guide the light toward the display surface. The reflecting sheet includes a generally rectangular main section and a side section extending from the main section. The main section is provided with a plurality of openings or perforations through which the light sources mounted on the light-source substrate may pass or be exposed. By arranging the reflecting sheet around the light sources in this manner, light emitted laterally or backward from the light sources can be reflected and reused, thereby improving light utilization efficiency.

The side section of the reflecting sheet extends from an edge of the main section and is arranged along an inner side surface of the rear frame. This side section helps control light that travels toward the peripheral region of the device. In particular, the side section includes a plurality of dots formed on its surface. These dots are configured to adjust the reflectance of the reflecting sheet in the side region.

The dots are arranged so that their size progressively increases from a corner portion of the side section toward another region of the side section. As the dot size increases, the reflectance of the side section is gradually reduced. This gradual change in reflectance allows the amount of reflected light to be controlled more precisely near the corner and side portions of the display device, where uneven brightness can otherwise occur.

By reducing excessive reflection in selected areas and gradually varying the reflective characteristics of the side section, the display device can suppress local brightness irregularities. As a result, light emitted from the light sources can be distributed more uniformly across the display panel. This configuration improves overall display quality by enhancing luminance uniformity and reducing visible unevenness, particularly near edge and corner regions of the display screen.
outputs.L5:
**The Power of “The”**

“The” may be one of the smallest words in the English language, but it plays a very important role. It is called a definite article, and it helps us talk about something specific. For example, when we say “a book,” we could mean any book. But when we say “the book,” we mean a particular book that the speaker and listener both know about.

This simple word gives clarity and direction to communication. It points to people, places, objects, and ideas that are already known or unique. We say “the sun” because there is only one sun that matters to us in everyday life. We say “the teacher” when we are talking about a specific teacher.

Although “the” is short, it appears everywhere in English. It helps sentences feel complete and natural. Without it, speech can sound unclear or incomplete. In this way, “the” proves that even the smallest words can have great importance.

a rear frame including a bottom portion and a side portion extending from the bottom portion;  

an LED substrate disposed on the bottom portion of the rear frame and including a plurality of light emitting diodes;

counterfactuals.prompt: Generate a patent-style description of a display device structure where a reflecting sheet sits on an LED substrate, includes holes for LEDs, extends toward a side wall, and has dot patterns that lower reflectance and gradually increase in size from a corner.
counterfactuals.output:
A display device includes a display panel, a light source unit disposed behind the display panel, and a reflecting member disposed to face the display panel. The light source unit includes an LED substrate and a plurality of light emitting diodes mounted on the LED substrate. The reflecting member is disposed on the LED substrate and includes a plurality of through holes through which the respective light emitting diodes are exposed.

The display device may include a bottom chassis having a bottom portion and a side wall extending from an edge of the bottom portion. The LED substrate is disposed on the bottom portion of the bottom chassis, and the reflecting member is supported by the LED substrate and extends outwardly beyond at least one edge of the LED substrate toward the side wall of the bottom chassis. Accordingly, light emitted from the light emitting diodes may be reflected toward the display panel not only at a region corresponding to the LED substrate, but also at a peripheral region between the LED substrate and the side wall.

The reflecting member has a reflective surface facing the display panel. A plurality of dot patterns are provided on the reflective surface. The dot patterns are configured to reduce reflectance of the reflecting member at regions where the dot patterns are formed. Each dot pattern may include a printed pattern, a coating pattern, a roughened pattern, or any other pattern having reflectance lower than that of the reflecting member.

The dot patterns are arranged such that sizes of the dot patterns gradually increase with increasing distance from a corner region of the reflecting member. In one embodiment, dot patterns positioned adjacent to a corner of the reflecting member have relatively small areas, and dot patterns positioned farther away from the corner have relatively larger areas. The gradual increase in size of the dot patterns may reduce localized brightness variations, suppress bright spots or dark regions, and improve luminance uniformity of light supplied to the display panel.

In some embodiments, the reflecting member includes a main reflecting portion overlapping the LED substrate and an extension reflecting portion extending from the main reflecting portion toward the side wall. The dot patterns may be formed on at least one of the main reflecting portion and the extension reflecting portion. The dot patterns may be arranged in rows, columns, or a matrix form, and may have circular, elliptical, polygonal, stripe-shaped, or irregular shapes.

The reflecting member may be formed of a white reflective resin sheet, a metal-coated sheet, a multilayer reflective film, or a plastic sheet having a reflective coating. The through holes of the reflecting member may be aligned with the light emitting diodes such that each light emitting diode protrudes through, or is exposed within, a corresponding through hole. The reflecting member may be fixed to the LED substrate by an adhesive layer, mechanical fastening, thermal bonding, or pressure fitting.

By disposing the reflecting member directly on the LED substrate, providing holes corresponding to the light emitting diodes, extending the reflecting member toward the side wall, and forming dot patterns with reduced reflectance that gradually increase in size from the corner region, the display device may enhance optical efficiency while improving brightness uniformity across the display panel.
counterfactuals.label: cf_4
